headline: Mangalam Cement files SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Mangalam Cement Limited has filed a disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares or voting rights in the company triggering mandatory disclosure obligations.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure is mandatory upon acquisition of ≥5% shares/voting rights and signals material change in shareholding structure; the acquiring party's identity and acquisition quantum are key to assessing control implications and trigger for open offer obligations.
detail: The disclosure was filed with NSE under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, which mandates disclosure within 2 trading days of acquisition of shares/voting rights crossing the 5% threshold. The filing indicates a substantial acquisition event in Mangalam Cement Limited; the specific acquiror, quantum of shares, consideration and timeline are contained in the detailed disclosure document filed with the exchange.
